verdict.rationale: A repository agent-readiness report is a fair capability to ask of a coding-agent platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one. The closest item, the SDK critic, scores predicted success of an agent's run while it executes. It does not assess how ready a repository is for autonomous agents, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
